SUMMARY: 옆으로 땋은 청록 머리와 해협의 물결을 닮은 드레스.
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult Turkish woman — the personification of the city of Istanbul — one woman who IS Istanbul as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a soft, gentle warmth; light warm-beige skin with a golden undertone; heart-shaped face; soft almond eyes with gently lowered outer corners; sapphire-blue eyes; soft rounded brows; a nose with a slightly upturned tip; lips with a defined cupid's bow, of natural size.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: willowy and long-limbed with soft curves — a full bust, rounded hips and a slender waist build; a low side-swept fishtail braid draped over one shoulder, with short loose wisps around her cheeks; teal hair.
Expression: an attentive, peaceful gaze and relaxed closed lips.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — FANTASY
Costume: grand, opulent dress of a mythic court cut to the outfit silhouette below — rich silk brocade dense with gold-thread embroidery, gilded filigree and jewel settings, enchanted jewelry with a soft magical glow; the city's symbol worked into the embroidery and jewels.
City motif: an Ottoman kaftan-cut court robe of ivory silk brocade worn open over a long gown, its front panels and wide sleeves woven with Iznik tulips, carnations and long serrated saz leaves in turquoise, cobalt blue and coral red and edged in gold; on her head a gold filigree crown built as a cascade of small domes and half-domes stepping up to one great central dome, set with turquoises.
World marks on her: layered gold-thread embroidery; a jeweled hair ornament; flowing silk ribbons trailing in the air; heraldic emblems worked in gold; glowing enchanted jewelry; heavy silk brocade; gilded filigree; a jeweled pendant with silk tassels at her waist; banners and royal regalia; a shimmer of magical light.
Silhouette: layered panels flowing like waves, strands of pearls and a shell-shaped headdress — a rippling tide-oracle silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Design idea: Two separate banks of silk panels curve around an open cobalt centre panel, integrating the two shores and the winding channel between them into the actual cut of the skirt.
Colours: Iznik turquoise, cobalt blue and burnished gold on ivory, with coral red only in the tulips — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a small pierced gold lantern with panes of turquoise glass, a warm light glowing within; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her outfit opens to show skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and arms, a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, and a high slit or a short hem showing the thigh; the ornaments stay on and symmetrical. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: a radiant capital of a myth-world spanning two continents at a rose-gold dawn: a shining strait running between the shores of Europe and Asia; on the seven hills of the old city vast domed halls with half-domes cascading down their sides and slender, pencil-thin minarets beside them, the oldest and greatest dome seeming to float on a ring of forty arched windows pouring with light, and facing it a domed hall with six slender minarets and walls glowing with blue flowered tiles; across a golden inlet a round stone tower crowned with a tall conical cap on its hill; at the mouth of the strait a small white tower on an islet with a lamp burning at its top; galleys with silk sails crossing between the two shores, tulip gardens in bloom and silk lanterns glowing in the air.
This card: on a high marble terrace of the old city at dawn, great domes with cascading half-domes and slender minarets rising behind her and the shining strait between the two continents glowing gold beyond.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: She holds the lantern by its ring just outside the hip; her free hand is relaxed beside her with the fingers naturally separated.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: corset, modern material, machinery, second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin, smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles.
